title: Blogger Widget Settings Master Catalog
description: Exhaustive registry of valid <b:widget-setting name="..."> keys across all official Blogger gadget types in Layouts v3.

AdSense.description: Google AdSense ad slot configuration, publisher client ID, and slot dimension parameters.

style.layout.description: Target ad format dimensions or responsive flag ('1x1'). Governs the ad unit geometry.

style.bgcolor.reason: Prohibited legacy ad styling setting. Declaring this setting causes Blogger compiler rejection: 'Unknown ad unit type'.

style.bordercolor.reason: Prohibited legacy ad styling setting. Declaring this setting causes Blogger compiler rejection: 'Unknown ad unit type'.

style.linkcolor.reason: Prohibited legacy ad styling setting. Declaring this setting causes Blogger compiler rejection: 'Unknown ad unit type'.

style.textcolor.reason: Prohibited legacy ad styling setting. Declaring this setting causes Blogger compiler rejection: 'Unknown ad unit type'.

style.unittype.reason: Prohibited legacy ad styling setting. Declaring this setting causes Blogger compiler rejection: 'Unknown ad unit type'.

style.urlcolor.reason: Prohibited legacy ad styling setting. Declaring this setting causes Blogger compiler rejection: 'Unknown ad unit type'.

Attribution.description: Theme author credits, copyright notices, and platform attribution markup.

copyright.description: Custom copyright or attribution notice text payload.

Blog.description: Canonical post model, comments, author data, pagination, labels, and feed links.

authorLabel.description: Custom text prefix preceding post author name. In Layouts v3, modern themes resolve author prefixes via data:messages.by.

commentLabel.description: Custom label text for post comment link. In Layouts v3, modern themes resolve comment strings via data:allBylineItems.comments.label or data:messages.comments.

postLabelsLabel.description: Custom prefix label preceding post tag/label links. In Layouts v3, modern themes resolve label strings via data:messages.labels.

postLocationLabel.description: Custom label text preceding post geo-location. In Layouts v3, modern themes resolve location strings via data:allBylineItems.location.label.

postsPerAd.description: Number of blog posts rendered between each inline AdSense ad unit.

showAuthor.description: Toggle visibility of post author byline.

showAuthorProfile.description: Toggle display of author profile information in post footer.

showCommentLink.description: Toggle visibility of comment count and comment link.

showDateHeader.description: Toggle grouping and display of post date headers.

showInlineAds.description: Toggle injection of inline AdSense ads between blog posts.

showLocation.description: Toggle display of post geo-location metadata.

showShareButtons.description: Toggle display of social share buttons.

showTimestamp.description: Toggle display of post publication time/timestamp.

style.layout.description: Ad format geometry for inline AdSense ads embedded within posts.

timestampLabel.description: Custom text prefix preceding post timestamp. In Layouts v3, modern themes format publication timestamps via date operators.

backlinksLabel.reason: External blog backlink tracking was retired.

reactionsLabel.reason: Blogger reaction rating system was decommissioned in modern responsive themes.

showBacklinks.reason: External blog backlink tracking was retired.

showReactions.reason: Blogger reaction rating system was decommissioned in modern responsive themes.

style.bgcolor.reason: Prohibited legacy ad styling setting. Declaring this setting causes Blogger compiler rejection: 'Unknown ad unit type'.

style.bordercolor.reason: Prohibited legacy ad styling setting. Declaring this setting causes Blogger compiler rejection: 'Unknown ad unit type'.

style.linkcolor.reason: Prohibited legacy ad styling setting. Declaring this setting causes Blogger compiler rejection: 'Unknown ad unit type'.

style.textcolor.reason: Prohibited legacy ad styling setting. Declaring this setting causes Blogger compiler rejection: 'Unknown ad unit type'.

style.unittype.reason: Prohibited legacy ad styling setting. Declaring this setting causes Blogger compiler rejection: 'Unknown ad unit type'.

style.urlcolor.reason: Prohibited legacy ad styling setting. Declaring this setting causes Blogger compiler rejection: 'Unknown ad unit type'.

BlogArchive.description: Hierarchical date archives, monthly/yearly post trees, and flat count lists.

chronological.description: Toggle chronological ordering of archive intervals (oldest first if true, newest first if false).

dayPattern.description: SimpleDateFormat pattern for daily archive navigation links.

frequency.description: Grouping interval frequency for archive links.

monthPattern.description: SimpleDateFormat pattern for monthly archive navigation links.

showPosts.description: Toggle listing of individual post titles within archive time intervals.

showStyle.description: Presentation format for archive links hierarchy.

showWeekEnd.description: Toggle display of week end date in weekly archive links.

weekPattern.description: SimpleDateFormat pattern for weekly archive navigation links.

yearPattern.description: SimpleDateFormat pattern for yearly archive navigation links.

BlogList.description: Curated blogroll showing recent updates, snippet excerpts, and author avatars.

numItemsToShow.description: Maximum number of external blogs displayed in the blogroll.

showItemSnippet.description: Toggle display of recent post snippet text.

showItemThumbnail.description: Toggle display of recent post thumbnail image.

showItemTitle.description: Toggle display of recent post title.

showTimePeriodSinceLastUpdate.description: Toggle display of relative time since blog last updated.

BlogSearch.description: Internal site search form header and configuration.

BloggerButton.description: Official Powered by Blogger badge URLs and graphic assets.

button.description: Hosted asset URL for selected Blogger promotional badge graphic.

ContactForm.description: Secure contact form endpoint identifiers and localized field labels.

FeaturedPost.description: Pinned article showcase schema, post hero image, and formatted snippets.

postId.description: Numeric ID of post selected for pinned display (or 0 if using most recent post).

showFirstImage.description: Toggle display of post lead/featured image hero thumbnail.

showPostTitle.description: Toggle display of featured post title.

showSnippet.description: Toggle display of post summary snippet text.

useMostRecentPost.description: Toggle automatic selection of latest published blog post as featured item.

Feed.description: External RSS/Atom syndication endpoint configuration, entry limits, and client hydration options.

feedUrl.description: Source URL of external RSS or Atom feed.

numItemsShow.description: Maximum number of syndicated feed entries to render.

openLinksInNewWindow.description: Toggle opening feed item links in new browser tab/window.

showItemAuthor.description: Toggle display of syndicated feed item author.

showItemDate.description: Toggle display of publication date for feed items.

Followers.description: Sandboxed Google Friend Connect / Followers iframe embed snippet and header title.

borderColorTransparent.description: Toggle transparent border styling on the Followers iframe.

contentHeadlineColor.description: Hex color code for headline text within the Followers gadget.

contentLinkColor.description: Hex color code for primary hyperlinks within the Followers gadget.

contentSecondaryLinkColor.description: Hex color code for secondary hyperlinks within the Followers gadget.

contentSecondaryTextColor.description: Hex color code for secondary/subdued text within the Followers gadget.

contentTextColor.description: Hex color code for body text within the Followers gadget.

endcapLinkColor.description: Hex color code for endcap/footer hyperlinks within the Followers gadget.

endcapTextColor.description: Hex color code for endcap/footer text within the Followers gadget.

useTemplateDefaultStyles.description: Flag indicating whether default theme typography and palette styles apply to the gadget.

HTML.description: Arbitrary user HTML/JS or plain formatted text blocks.

content.description: Unescaped HTML, JavaScript, or plain text content wrapped in CDATA.

Header.description: Blog title, header hero banner, description, and image placement flags.

displayHeight.description: Rendered height dimension in pixels for header image (must be at least 1).

displayUrl.description: Hosted image URL for blog header background or replacement graphic.

displayWidth.description: Rendered width dimension in pixels for header image (must be at least 1).

imagePlacement.description: Layout placement strategy for header image relative to blog title and description.

shrinkToFit.description: Toggle automatic browser image scaling to container width.

useImage.description: Toggle display of custom header image (controls whether data:image is populated in Layouts v3).

sectionWidth.reason: Fluid CSS layout replaces fixed sectionWidth dimension constraints.

Image.description: Standalone image banner, caption, destination link, responsive srcset, and dimensions.

caption.description: Caption or descriptive text rendered beneath image.

displayHeight.description: Rendered height dimension in pixels for image (must be at least 1).

displayWidth.description: Rendered width dimension in pixels for image (must be at least 1).

link.description: Destination hyperlink URL when clicking image.

shrinkToFit.description: Toggle automatic image scaling to fit container width.

sectionWidth.reason: Fluid CSS layout replaces fixed sectionWidth dimension constraints.

Label.description: Category taxonomy, post counts per label, and cloud vs. list display modes.

selectedLabelsList.description: Comma-separated list of label names filtered when showType is USER_SELECTED.

showFreqNumbers.description: Toggle display of post count numbers beside each label.

showType.description: Label filtering mode (all labels vs user-selected labels).

shownum.description: Maximum number of links to display (must be at least 1).

sorting.description: Alphabetical sorting order for link items.

patterns.description: Destination URL for hyperlink entry at zero-based {index} (e.g. link-0, link-1, link-2). Deserialized into data:links[i].target within the data:links array.
Visible text label for hyperlink entry at zero-based {index} (correlates with link-{index}). Deserialized into data:links[i].name within the data:links array.

PageList.description: Static standalone page navigation links, home link, and active selection state.

homeTitle.description: Custom label text override for the root/home page link.

pageListJson.description: Serialized JSON navigation map. Must be valid unescaped JSON or unescaped CDATA encoding numeric page IDs, external links, titles, and sort positions. XML-escaped <![CDATA[...]]> causes compiler failure ('Page title is invalid.').

href.description: Target destination URL for page or external link.

title.description: Display title label for navigation item.

position.description: Zero-based sort order index within navigation bar.

PopularPosts.description: Ranked trending posts collection, thumbnail images, and comment counts.

numItemsToShow.description: Maximum number of popular posts displayed.

showSnippets.description: Toggle display of post excerpt snippets.

showThumbnails.description: Toggle display of post thumbnail images.

timeRange.description: Time window calculation period for popular post metrics.

Profile.description: Author biographical details, profile avatar, location, team contributors, and social links.

showaboutme.description: Toggle display of author 'About Me' biographical snippet.

showlocation.description: Toggle display of author geographical location.

ReportAbuse.description: System abuse reporting link gadget (DSA compliance, replaces legacy Navbar reporting channel).

Stats.description: Historical pageview counter, sparkline trend display flags, and stats endpoint URL.

showAnimatedCounter.description: Toggle animated scrolling number transition for pageview count.

showSparkline.description: Toggle display of historical pageview trend sparkline chart.

sparklineStyle.description: Visual styling palette and appearance parameters for sparkline chart. Encoded as style query parameter in data:statsUrl.

timeRange.description: Time window for visitor count aggregation. Encoded as timeRange query parameter in data:statsUrl.

Subscribe.description: Subscription feeds, aggregator reader targets, and platform feed icons.

Text.description: Rich-text and formatted content gadget displaying user-authored text notes or HTML payload.

content.description: Text content payload wrapped in CDATA.

TextList.description: Ordered or bulleted plain text item collections.

shownum.description: Maximum number of list items to render (must be at least 1).

sorting.description: Alphabetical sorting order for list items.

patterns.description: Text entry for list item at zero-based {index} (e.g. item-0, item-1, item-2). Deserialized into the data:items array.

Translate.description: Google Translate drop-down or button integration.

displayMode.description: Visual presentation layout format for Google Translate widget. Mapped in runtime to data:layout.

Wikipedia.description: Wikipedia search box interface messages and encyclopedic query tool.
